checklist.notes: The set directly addresses polite requests, situational appropriacy, information checking, and mediation.
Contrasting interlocutors and the explicit check-confirm-relay procedure make pragmatic choices visible and reusable.
Tasks move from translation and matching through procedural ordering and repair to freer mediation writing, though every task is marked medium.
Roles, situations, required facts, and output length are all specified.
Each task has a small information set and the final message preserves only three facts.
The Vietnamese request and travel-service contexts support practical formality choices without presenting one formula as universally mandatory.
Five bounded medium tasks remain reasonable, with the final response limited to two sentences.

methods: Reviewed the exercise set and audit against the declared original project-authored policy and external-payload/media declarations.
copyright_originality_check.scope_limitations: No Internet-wide copyright or plagiarism search was performed; this review checked only the declared original project-authored policy and supplied artifact evidence.

findings.description: All five tasks are labelled medium, and the set opens with productive translation rather than a lower-demand recognition scaffold.
findings.recommendation: Consider beginning with situational matching, then move to translation and free mediation.

limitations: This is an independent AI pedagogical review for development evidence, not human review or release approval.
The review covers the supplied immutable exercise set and automated audit; it does not report an Internet-wide originality search.
